{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders (they were already confirmed to be 0)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders after cleanup: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Filter population: converted and completed
df_filtered = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f'Final population size: {len(df_filtered)}')

# Check cross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment to assess confounding
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['customer_segment']))"}
